QuestInfo.name: [Maple Castle] The Full Moon Dream
QuestInfo.0: Geez, Neinheart doesn't even believe the letter is real! His face turned awfully red, though...
QuestInfo.1: What is Neinheart on about? Return to #bMaple Castle#k and find out what happened.
QuestInfo.2: You returned to the Maple Castle and learned the truth. Shock!

0.0: This letter is a FAKE! Explain yourself! What possible reason would you have to trick me like this? Who put you up to this?\r\n#L0##bYou tell Neinheart what happened at Maple Castle.#l\n#k
0.1: What are you talking about? #bMaple Castle#k is a legend. No one knows where it is. I've never been there, and the empress is far too busy to leave Ereve like that. Hm...tell me more about this place.

yes.0: ...Really. That's unbelievable. We need to investigate #bMaple Castle#k immediately, especially on whoever it was that impersonated the empress. Can I count on your support?
yes.1: Thank you. Return to the castle, and find the ones responsible for this ruse. If you find them, #beliminate them for me#k? We cannot allow impersonators to besmirch the good name of the empress!
yes.2: I wonder, though... The handwriting on this letter is ancient. We need answers from #bMaple Castle#k immediately.

no.0: Someone impersonated the empress! Don't just leave!
